drafts.title: Temperature
drafts.pitch: At temperature 0, Cursor orders the same sandwich every day. At temperature 1, it orders a sandwich made of the color purple.
drafts.reason: The most-told joke about language models. It was also the only joke in this site's original scaffold, which is a little sad.

drafts.title: Absolutely Right
drafts.pitch: Tilde tests Cursor by stating three wrong facts in a row. Cursor agrees with each one, louder every time.
drafts.reason: It lands, but the sycophancy joke is everywhere this year. Save it until canon can make it specific to this cast.
